items.text: In the six months after the switch to structured templates, what proportion of abdominal and pelvic CT reports for suspected appendicitis, bowel obstruction and cancer staging contain all pre-specified key elements, and how does this compare with free-text reports from the six months before?
items.population: Abdominal and pelvic CT reports for three index questions
items.comparator: Free-text reports from the six months before, rated with a stated-or-implied rule
items.time: January to July 2027 against July 2026 to January 2027

finer: Feasible with 3 registrar hours a week; interesting to radiologists and referrers; novel locally; ethical as a service evaluation; relevant to whether the template stays.
summary: One PICO question with a historic reference.
